title: An endpoint to clear cached images
summary:
Image caches gained a delete endpoint, an Android project joined the directory, and model metadata and usage accounting got tidier.

Added `DELETE /delete/prompt/:prompt` to invalidate an image cache entry using the original prompt and query parameters. The JSON response reports the result of each deletion attempt.

The Chat projects listing now includes @BiG L’s Android app for Pollinations-powered chat, web search, and image generation.

Text and image model listings now show prices in Pollen and return `is_specialized` instead of `isSpecialized`. Shared registry metadata also keeps Enter’s model descriptions and modalities aligned.
